messages:
chao: kicking off gpu fleet onboard in ap-south-2, we started bootstrap for nodepool-gpu-1 at ~10:00UTC
lina: saw some failed kube-probes on gpu nodes after bootstrap, nothing obvious yet
sam: copying logs: 
```
kubelet[1234]: E0921 10:02:13 kubelet_node_status.go:123] Failed to update node status: failed to set Readiness: network unreachable
2026-09-21T10:02:12Z CNI plugin netplan apply: default route set to eth1 (mgmt) not eth0 (data)
```
ryan: netplan? we don't use netplan in node-image, who changed that?
chao: terraform module applied node-image patch from image-build-team last night. it includes a netplan config to set metric for mgmt nic. might be the culprit
lina: healthchecks target data interface (eth0) for nvlink and GPU telemetry, if default route points to mgmt then we cross-nat to another AZ for GPU registry calls
sam: that explains high cross-AZ egress and failed pulls for the nvtool container
deploy-bot: terraform apply finished for infra/gpu/ap-south-2 (plan id: plan-0a3f) :white_check_mark:
oncall-bot: incident created #INC-2026-4822, paging infra-sre (sev: high)
infra-sre: I'm on pager, jumping in. Can someone paste netplan content from a broken node?
sam: paste below:
```
network:
  ethernets:
    eth0:
      dhcp4: true
      routes:
        - to: 0.0.0.0/0
          via: 10.0.0.1
          metric: 200
    eth1:
      dhcp4: true
      routes:
        - to: 0.0.0.0/0
          via: 172.16.0.1
          metric: 100
```
ryan: so eth1 (mgmt) has lower metric -> default route via mgmt
chao: image-build-team intended mgmt to be preferred for controller-plane ops, but for GPU nodes data plane must be preferred. Miscommunication
lina: quick mitigation: flip metrics live via provisioning hook? But nodes already booted and registered
infra-sre: two options: 1) roll back image patch (slow, needs new AMI) 2) patch netplan via DaemonSet / ssh and restart networking (faster but riskier)
sam: how many nodes affected?
chao: nodepool-gpu-1: 12/24 nodes show probe failures, others in different AZ healthy. Looks like image was only used on this nodepool
ryan: cost concern: noticed unexpected egress billing spikes to another AZ for those nodes in last 30m
lina: we should avoid mass ssh patching. Suggest canary: patch 1 node, validate kube-probe, container pull and nvtool start, then roll with DaemonSet and graceful drains
infra-sre: agreed. Create DaemonSet that rewrites /etc/netplan/50-cloud-init.yaml and runs `netplan apply` with systemd-networkd restart. Use rolloutPaused flag and a 10m wait between nodes
chao: creating quick DaemonSet now, will label canary node: gpu-canary-01
sam: also add iptables rule to avoid cross-AZ egress during test? we don't want big bills if other nodes still misrouted
ryan: good call, add egress-block rule for the canary until validated
deploy-bot: kubectl apply -f ds-netplan-fix.yaml -> created daemonset/ds-netplan-fix
infra-sre: performing canary patch on gpu-canary-01
lina: netplan applied, systemd-networkd restarted on canary. kubelet reported Ready after 18s
sam: nvtool started, GPU telemetry up, no cross-AZ flows observed for canary
ryan: costs look stable for canary, egress not spiking
chao: rolling out to remaining failing nodes with 30s delay between pods, will cordon+drain each node before patch
infra-sre: note to runbook: ensure DaemonSet has nodeSelector node-role/gpu and tolerations for gpu taints. Add preflight to detect netplan metrics mismatch earlier
sam: half-rollout complete, 6 more nodes to go
lina: one node failed to come back Ready after patch, kubelet failing on mount of nvproxy.sock - restarting kubelet fixed it
infra-sre: record that step in postmortem and add a systemd service restart to DaemonSet post-run to be safe
chao: rolling finish - all 12 nodes patched and Ready. nvtool telemetry green, no further probe failures
oncall-bot: INC-2026-4822 resolved (root cause: unintended netplan metric change in image patch) :white_check_mark:
ryan: next actions: 1) block image-build patch from landing until image tests include GPU netplan validation 2) create a bake job that verifies data interface default route on GPU images 3) cost alert threshold for cross-AZ egress per nodepool
infra-sre: adding to backlog and will create a short runbook update for ap-south-2 bring-up sequence (bootstrap -> netplan validation -> canary -> full rollout)
lina: thanks everyone. shout if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
